brief.audience: Homeowners, renovators and small business operators comparing an electrician service site structure.
brief.primaryAction: Start a project inquiry after reviewing the service fit and working method.
brief.content: Fictional Copperline Electric demo. It uses honest illustrative service language and avoids real licenses, reviews, customer outcomes, response times and availability claims.
brief.imagery: Distinct generated photography roles: panel assessment hero, renovation rewiring detail, finished lighting interior and collaborative team planning. Two SVG logo treatments support light and dark surfaces.
